title: Mount Dora Paranormal Ghost Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the haunted history of Mount Dora on a unique ghost adventure that takes you through its picturesque streets and storied past. Starting in the lobby of the historic Lakeside Inn, this interactive tour immerses you in a hands-on paranormal investigation. Equipped with real ghost-hunting tools, uncover chilling tales and documented encounters as you visit haunted historical buildings and learn about the town's mysterious happenings. This engaging experience is perfect for skeptics and believers alike, promising an unforgettable evening in one of Florida’s charming small towns.

- Start your journey at the iconic Lakeside Inn, established in 1883
- Approximately 2-hour tour featuring hands-on paranormal investigations
- Explore haunted sites and hear chilling stories of Mount Dora's past
- Ideal for both locals and visitors, blending history with the supernatural
